name: All-Over Print Socks
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:

-Made from high-quality polyester fabric, these socks provide a soft, breathable, and comfortable wearing experience throughout the day.

-The elastic cuff design ensures a secure fit while allowing flexible movement without feeling too tight.

-Full cushioning and thick padding help provide extra comfort and support for your feet.

-The seamless toe design reduces irritation and creates a smoother, more comfortable fit.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:

-Size S: Height: 19 cm | Length: 18 cm | Foot Length: 16–19 cm

-Size M: Height: 21 cm | Length: 21 cm | Foot Length: 19–22 cm

-Size L: Height: 23 cm | Length: 23 cm | Foot Length: 20–25 cm

 

  • Printing Technology:

- Features sublimation technology, allowing vibrant designs to cover the entire sock surface.

-Please note that due to the nature of the fabric, printed images may appear slightly softer compared to the original design file.

 

  • Functional & Usage:

Perfect for everyday wear and various occasions, including:

-Daily outfits and casual styling

-Sports, workouts, and outdoor activities

-Adding a personalized touch to your fashion look

The stretchable fabric and comfortable fit make them easy to wear all day long.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:

- A thoughtful and unique gift for birthdays, holidays, anniversaries, and special celebrations.

- Perfect for family, friends, couples, teams, or anyone who loves personalized fashion items.

- Custom designs make these socks a memorable and creative gift choice.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 5-7 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 7-15 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1xAll-Over Print Socks

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 1-3 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
